payload.title: IPC staff health bundle omits the health due employee ID source
payload.actual: The bundle names POST /personnel/training-sessions as the only this_screen employee_id source. Existing employees who need a pre-employment medical or a dose appear in GET /personnel/health/due with employee_id; recording a training attendance should not be a prerequisite to opening their health record.
payload.expected: List GET /personnel/health/due -> employee_id as an alternate source for both health endpoints. The health-due rule explicitly starts with missing medicals, incomplete courses and checks due.
payload.evidence: demo.ipc GET /personnel/health/due 200 request 72e328a5bb4a448b903a4a18f0e551c3; 35 rows with employee_id. GET /personnel/training-sessions 200 request 05048ee504ad4d52bcb0e847781772eb; directory rows have no attendees/employee_id. No write or private response values were used.
